_comment: D18. refuse: a public stateful method that writes state (a mutable property, directly or through a private helper) and calls addRawOutput but never addOutput (directly or through a helper) gets no auto-injected continuation (any addOutput/addRawOutput replaces it), so its state write is silently dropped and the contract's satoshis go to the spender's change; every tier refuses it with the shared diagnostic, on the source path (typecheck) and on the --ir path (ir-release-trap.test.ts). addDataOutput does not suppress the continuation and is no trigger. accept: a method that writes nothing and emits raw outputs (terminal by design), and a write carried by an addOutput (direct or in a helper), compile in every tier to the same bytes. The rule is PER PATH: in a method that declares any addOutput/addRawOutput (which removes the auto-continuation for the whole method), every path that writes state must reach an addOutput; a write on a raw-output branch beside an addOutput branch, and a write before an addOutput only one branch reaches (directly or in a helper), are refused; a path that writes nothing ends the contract by design and is accepted.
error_template: method '<method>' writes contract state on a path that reaches no addOutput(): a method that declares its own outputs (addOutput/addRawOutput) gets no auto-injected continuation, so on that path the state write would be lost and the contract's satoshis would leave with the spend. Add this.addOutput(satoshis, ...) on every path that writes state, or stop writing state on a path meant to end the contract
